description: This file defines the MyInfoMenuConfigurator class, which implements menu configuration for the 'My Info' menu item within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It utilizes the MenuServiceTrait to retrieve a specific menu item based on its title.

classes.name: MyInfoMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the 'My Info' menu item display and retrieval for the HRM interface.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Retrieves the MenuItem with the title 'My Info' for the specified screen.
